name: Nuvio
summary: AI-native finance software that invoices, scans receipts, reconciles and analyses cash flow, with optional bookkeeping and sales-tax filing.
description: Nuvio is AI-native finance software with invoicing, payment tracking, AI receipt and invoice scanning, AI-powered reconciliation, analytics, cash flow, project financials, multi-currency and an AI assistant. Each plan is offered with a “Start for free” action on the pricing page. This is a 5.0-era product that appeared on Product Hunt around 27 October 2026 (widened window) and was not already in the restore3-new catalogue.

pricing.details: App Only 49 €/month; App & Bookkeeping 222 €/month; Bookkeeping + Tax 490 €/month. The pricing page also offers to start for free.
